The '''Life Day clone trooper armor''' was a purchasable [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] armor uniform. It consisted of regular clone armor with some [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] lights attached to it. The full armor cost 2,200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].

==Behind the scenes==
This outfit was only purchasable during [[Wikipedia:Christmas|Christmas]] time. It was available for anyone to buy.
